paragraphs.text: Open-plan offices were meant to encourage conversation between colleagues. Research at two large companies found the opposite: after moving from private offices to open spaces, face-to-face interaction fell by around 70 per cent, while emails increased.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Many workers respond by wearing headphones, which signal that they do not wish to be disturbed. This may help concentration, but managers report that it can make new employees reluctant to ask questions.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Some companies have introduced quiet rooms that can be booked for work requiring concentration. Staff use them heavily, yet surveys show that the rooms are often full when they are most needed.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Designers now favour mixed layouts, with open areas for teamwork, small meeting rooms and desks separated by screens or plants. Early studies suggest that such offices improve satisfaction, although they need more floor space.
paragraphs.label: D

paragraphs.text: Some firms now allow employees to choose where they work each day, including from home, which reduces the number of desks that are needed.
paragraphs.label: E

items.quote: Open-plan offices were meant to encourage conversation between colleagues

explanation.en: “were meant to encourage conversation between colleagues” → E. F sounds plausible, but the text says nothing about saving money.
explanation.kk: «were meant to encourage conversation between colleagues» → E. F сенімді естіледі, бірақ мәтінде үнемдеу туралы ештеңе жоқ.
explanation.ru: «were meant to encourage conversation between colleagues» → E. F звучит правдоподобно, но об экономии в тексте ничего нет.

items.quote: face-to-face interaction fell by around 70 per cent
items.prompt: The move from private offices to open spaces

explanation.en: After the move “face-to-face interaction fell by around 70 per cent” → A. “Sharply” reflects the 70 per cent.
explanation.kk: Көшкеннен кейін «face-to-face interaction fell by around 70 per cent» → A. «Sharply» — 70 пайызды білдіреді.
explanation.ru: После переезда «face-to-face interaction fell by around 70 per cent» → A. «Sharply» передаёт 70 процентов.

items.quote: it can make new employees reluctant to ask questions

explanation.en: Headphones “can make new employees reluctant to ask questions” → B. “Discourage … from asking” paraphrases “reluctant to ask”.
explanation.kk: Құлаққап «can make new employees reluctant to ask questions» → B. «Discourage … from asking» — «reluctant to ask» дегеннің басқаша айтылымы.
explanation.ru: Наушники «can make new employees reluctant to ask questions» → B. «Discourage … from asking» пересказывает «reluctant to ask».

items.quote: the rooms are often full when they are most needed
keywords: often full when they are most needed

explanation.en: Quiet rooms are popular, but “the rooms are often full when they are most needed”, so they are unavailable at the worst time → C.
explanation.kk: Тыныш бөлмелер жиі пайдаланылады, бірақ «the rooms are often full when they are most needed». Толы бөлме дәл керек кезде қолжетімсіз → C.
explanation.ru: Тихими комнатами пользуются много, но «the rooms are often full when they are most needed». Занятые комнаты недоступны именно тогда, когда нужны → C.

items.quote: such offices improve satisfaction, although they need more floor space

explanation.en: Mixed layouts “need more floor space” → D. G is a trap: open-plan offices have not been removed.
explanation.kk: Аралас кеңселер «need more floor space» → D. G — тұзақ: ашық кеңселерді ешкім алып тастамаған.
explanation.ru: Смешанные офисы «need more floor space» → D. G — ловушка: open-plan никто не убирал.

require more space than simple open offices.
